summary: List data formats currently available on the selected clipboard.

target.notes: Use a native clipboard service; preserve Electron type selection and data-format behavior.

semantics.ordering: platform/Electron defined; do not sort unless proven unobservable

caveats: MIME/native format names are platform dependent; compiler must not normalize them casually.

tests.name: list formats
tests.expected_behavior: returns formats advertised by the clipboard

tests.name: format order
tests.expected_behavior: preserve backend-reported order; do not impose a new sort order
